testCases.label: Verify adding elements to array
testCases.description: Adds multiple items to the array via input field and push button, then asserts that the array content matches the expected comma-separated string.

testCases.label: Verify popping elements from array
testCases.description: Adds multiple items to the array, then clicks the pop button and asserts that the last item is removed from the array content.

testCases.label: Verify array length after adding items
testCases.description: Clicks the push button multiple times and checks that the length element reflects the correct number of items added.

testCases.label: Verify array length after adding and popping items
testCases.description: Adds multiple items and then pops one, asserting that the length element correctly shows the updated count.
